value: Instruction-following, reasoning, and coding in a single model; agentic use with native function calling and JSON output; multimodal (text and image input, text output) analysis of images. Reasoning effort 'high' recommended for complex tasks and agentic coding. Replaces Devstral 2 in the Vibe coding agent and powers Le Chat.
quote:
It is a dense 128B model with a 256k context window, handling instruction-following, reasoning,
and coding in a single set of weights. [...] **Agentic**: Best-in-class agentic capabilities with native function calling and JSON output. [...] **Vision**: Analyzes images and provides insights based on visual content, in addition to text. [...] Use `reasoning_effort="high"` for complex tasks and agentic coding. [...] Due to its stronger agentic capabilities, Mistral Medium 3.5 replaces Devstral 2 in our coding agent, Vibe CLI.
quotes:
It is a dense 128B model with a 256k context window, handling instruction-following, reasoning,
and coding in a single set of weights.
**Agentic**: Best-in-class agentic capabilities with native function calling and JSON output.
**Vision**: Analyzes images and provides insights based on visual content, in addition to text.
Use `reasoning_effort="high"` for complex tasks and agentic coding.
Due to its stronger agentic capabilities, Mistral Medium 3.5 replaces Devstral 2 in our coding agent, Vibe CLI.

value: The card notes a Transformers config error that caused long-context performance degradation (fixed in a later commit); GGUFs generated from the earlier config are also affected, and frameworks relying on the config must be updated or performance will be subpar, especially in long-context sessions. It also says local serving may be subpar, in which case the Mistral AI API is recommended.
